pages.text: Processors are one of the primary ingredients in AE2 $(l:ae2_mechanics/devices)devices$(/l) and machines. They are also one of your first big automation challenges. There are three types of processor, made with gold, $(l:items_blocks_machines/certus_quartz_crystal)Certus Quartz Crystal$(/l), and diamond respectively. They are made using $(l:items_blocks_machines/presses)presses$(/l) in an $(l:items_blocks_machines/inscriber)Inscriber$(/l), in a multi-step process (usually achieved via a series of inscribers and filtered piping).

pages.title: Production Steps
pages.text: 1. Gather/make the required ingredients: silicon, redstone, gold, $(l:items_blocks_machines/certus_quartz_crystal)Certus Quartz Crystal$(/l), diamond.
